Entry Social Hierarchy of the Dothraki Sea Entry Social Hierarchy of the Dothraki Sea The Khal maintains his authority with spoils, courage, and the ability to care for his followers, while ordinary riders judge whether they are worthy of following based on horses, kin, and assignments; the same order may appear in the hall Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.

Entry Social Hierarchy of the Dothraki Sea Entry Social Hierarchy of the Dothraki Sea The Khal maintains his authority with spoils, courage, and the ability to care for his followers, while ordinary riders judge whether they are worthy of following based on horses, kin, and assignments; the same order may appear in the hall The distant system is not empty talk only if it can be implemented in campfires, city gates and inns.

Entry Social Hierarchy of the Dothraki Sea Entry Social Hierarchy of the Dothraki Sea The Khal maintains his authority with spoils, courage, and the ability to care for his followers, while ordinary riders judge whether they are worthy of following based on horses, kin, and assignments; the same order may appear in the hall If a rule is practiced over and over again, it will find its way into rituals, crafts, and prayers; if it is sustained only by fear, cracks will show at the onset of a crisis.
